# ContainerElementExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent extension methods for adding content elements to containers. These are typically terminal methods - they create an element and end the chain, or return the concrete element type for element-specific styling.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Methods

- [`Barcode`](#barcode): Adds a 1D barcode element (Code 128 by default).
- [`Canvas`](#canvas): Adds a canvas element for freeform drawing.
- [`Column`](#column): Adds a vertical column layout.
- [`Component`](#component): Composes a reusable component (created via parameterless constructor) into this container.
- [`DataMatrix`](#datamatrix): Adds a Data Matrix (ECC200) element.
- [`Element`](#element): Inserts any raw IElement into the fluent tree.
- [`Ellipse`](#ellipse): Adds a filled ellipse.
- [`Empty`](#empty): Adds an empty block to the container, which terminates the chain.
- [`Image`](#image): Adds an image from a file path.
- [`Line`](#line): Adds a horizontal line.
- [`PageBreak`](#pagebreak): Forces a page break.
- [`QRCode`](#qrcode): Adds a QR code element.
- [`Row`](#row): Adds a horizontal row layout.
- [`Spacer`](#spacer): Adds an invisible spacer that reserves the specified vertical space in points.
- [`Svg`](#svg): Adds an SVG file drawn as vector content.
- [`Table`](#table): Adds a table layout with columns, headers, footers, and auto-flowing cells.
- [`Text`](#text): Adds a simple text element.

### `Barcode`

```csharp
Barcode Barcode(IContentContainer c, string value, BarcodeSymbology symbology = BarcodeSymbology.Code128)
```

*static*

Adds a 1D barcode element (Code 128 by default).

### `Canvas`

```csharp
CanvasElement Canvas(IContentContainer c, float height, Action<ICanvas, float, float> handler)
```

*static*

Adds a canvas element for freeform drawing. The handler receives (canvas, width, height).

### `Column`

```csharp
void Column(IContentContainer c, Action<ColumnDescriptor> handler)
```

*static*

Adds a vertical column layout. Items are stacked top to bottom with automatic pagination.

### `Component`

```csharp
void Component(IContentContainer c)
void Component(IContentContainer c, IComponent component)
```

*static*

Composes a reusable component (created via parameterless constructor) into this container.

### `DataMatrix`

```csharp
DataMatrix DataMatrix(IContentContainer c, string data, float size = 100)
```

Adds a Data Matrix (ECC200) element.

### `Element`

```csharp
void Element(IContentContainer c, IElement element)
```

*static*

Inserts any raw IElement into the fluent tree. Use this to integrate elements from the standard API (charts, custom elements, etc.).

### `Ellipse`

```csharp
Ellipse Ellipse(IContentContainer c, float width, float height)
Ellipse Ellipse(IContentContainer c, float width, float height, Color color)
```

*static*

Adds a filled ellipse.

### `Empty`

```csharp
void Empty(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Adds an empty block to the container, which terminates the chain. Useful for colored spacer blocks or drawing backgrounds without content.

### `Image`

```csharp
Image Image(IContentContainer c, string path)
Image Image(IContentContainer c, byte[] data)
```

*static*

Adds an image from a file path. Returns the Image for further styling via existing ImageExtensions (.WithWidth(), .WithFitMode(), etc.).

### `Line`

```csharp
Line Line(IContentContainer c, float thickness = 1)
Line Line(IContentContainer c, float thickness, Color color)
```

*static*

Adds a horizontal line.

### `PageBreak`

```csharp
void PageBreak(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Forces a page break. The next element after this will start at the top of a new page. Has no effect if the current position is already at the top of a page.

### `QRCode`

```csharp
QRCode QRCode(IContentContainer c, string data, float size = 100)
```

*static*

Adds a QR code element.

### `Row`

```csharp
void Row(IContentContainer c, Action<RowDescriptor> handler)
```

*static*

Adds a horizontal row layout. Items are placed side by side.

### `Spacer`

### `Svg`

```csharp
Svg Svg(IContentContainer c, string path)
```

*static*

Adds an SVG file drawn as vector content. Returns the Svg for further configuration; for markup, add `new Svg { SvgData = ... }` with `Element`.

### `Table`

```csharp

```

*static*

Adds a table layout with columns, headers, footers, and auto-flowing cells.

### `Text`

```csharp

```
